title: Add English Persian direction and catalog parity
description: Verify locale routing, `lang`/`dir`, logical CSS properties, catalog key parity, and Persian UI behavior for the final release.
acceptanceCriteria: `en` and `fa` catalogs have identical key sets and no missing user-facing strings
Localized root sets correct `lang` and `dir`; logical direction is used for arrows, alignment, and controls
Representative routes render coherently in Persian without overflow, broken truncation, or LTR field leakage
A parity check fails on missing/extra keys and runs in CI or as a documented release gate

steps.description: Compare catalog key sets and assert root `lang`/`dir` for both locales; run before fixes to establish evidence.
Read next-intl routing/request, root layout, catalogs, and components with physical direction/arrow/alignment classes.
Add missing keys and replace only evidence-backed direction/layout issues; update both catalogs together.
Run parity check, representative browser routes in en/fa, typecheck, lint, and custom tests.

technicalNotes: Keep the `en`/`fa` pair synchronized; do not use ad-hoc English strings in Persian components.
